richiami.difetto: Incorrect assembly and torquing of the steering column components installed on the Tractor may have occurred which can lead to a loss of steering control.
richiami.rimedio: To address this issue we need to carry out some simple checks and/or corrections. The checks and/or corrections will be carried out by a Case IH/New Holland authorised dealer and will be free of charge. This precautionary operation is considered essential.
richiami.titolo: Steering column inspect and adjust – URGENT SAFETY PROGRAM

richiami.difetto: The teeth of the mechanical park brake pawl and ratchet can wear abnormally fast and may degrade possibly resulting in a loss of grip upon engagement of the handbrake. In the unlikely event of the hand brake lever self dis-engaging due to abnormal wear of the parts it can lead to an unexpected movement of the tractor.
richiami.modello: Puma 140 Puma 150 Puma 165 , Puma 140 Puma 150 Puma 165
richiami.rimedio: Replace either the hand brake lever assembly or for speciality ranges of tractors the hand brake lever pawl due to a different design of the part.

richiami.difetto: The current lock tab on the retaining nut lock washer of the front axle hub may bend or break.
richiami.rimedio: Replace on both left and right front axle wheel hub lock washers and retaining nuts.
